title: Synthetic dropout within 2 years
label: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — NOT REAL UNIVERSITY PREDICTIONS.
prediction_point: End date of each completed term (final grades posted). Features use records dated on or before it.
target_definition: target_dropout_2y = 1 if this programme admission ends in WITHDRAWN or DISMISSED and the outcome is recorded within 730 days after the prediction date; 0 otherwise (still studying, graduated, transferred, or withdrawal recorded later). Readmission later does not change the label.
population: Completed term enrolments whose admission outcome is not yet recorded at the prediction date and whose 2-year label horizon ends on or before the as-of date (2026-11-10).

excluded_leakage_columns.outcome: final outcome of the admission (determined after the prediction point)
excluded_leakage_columns.outcome_known_at_prediction: population filter only (rows with an already-known outcome are excluded)
